# Chat, arenas and a lot of polish
This build turns the chat into a proper messenger, puts your team on the home screen and lets you watch Battledome live.

## One chat picker
- Tap the **GIF** button in the chat: **Emoji · GIF · Stickers · Memes** in one place, powered by KLIPY
- Emoji go into your message; GIFs, stickers and memes are sent on tap and show as the image for NTL VANCED players
- Category chips, **Recent**, search with autocomplete, bento grid

## TEAM | GLOBAL in one box
- The Global chat now lives inside NTL’s chat box as a second tab — unread badge, USERS and NICK right there
- The picker works in both chats

## Team map on the home screen
- **BATTLEDOME · 2220 · 8828** with the live arena picture, your team members as their NTL icons, player counts and top ten
- Tap a member to see their arena, **JOIN** to go there

## Live Battledomes (experimental)
- **VIEW LIVE BATTLEDOMES** above PLAY: a live rendered preview of the arena — zone ring, food, snakes with names — plus players, top score, zone radius, top ten and JOIN, POWERED BY WYRM.

## Mobile controls, refined
- **Arrow control** runs on a virtual cursor: clamped to the screen, centre dead zone, re-seeds along your heading on every new touch — steady and predictable
- **Arrow & cursor skins** open a visual gallery in **Vanced › Controls** — every skin drawn, tap to use
- **Eleven new neon arrows**: Neon Ice / Magenta / Sunset / Aqua / Jade, Volt / Twin Volt / Heat / Streak, Inferno / Chrome
- On-screen **toggle buttons light up** while that mode is on (bot, SOS, spine, eyes, hide chat, assist lock…) — even if you flipped it with a key
- On-screen **Open settings** and **Realtime leaderboards** work mid-game, no bot mode needed
- **Revamp Keys** bindings now actually apply after Save
- On-screen keys respond while another finger is steering; controls never leak touches into the game

## Also
- **UI size** is a − / + stepper and now scales every popup
- New menu background; custom arena background accepts any image (png, webp, gif…)
- Home screen buttons appear instantly
- Mod panels sit on NTL’s own layer, so nothing floats over the settings page
